item: The GETs that reached the network or minted a signing key are POSTs (R278 P1/P4 adopted by R694)
key_paths: src/api/hazards.py; src/api/monitoring.py; src/api/wiki.py; src/api/geo.py; src/api/annotations.py; src/static/app-map.js; src/static/app-home.js; tests/test_get_cross_site_refusal.py
summary: POST /api/hazards, /api/monitoring/health, /api/wiki/dumps/probe, /api/wiki/dumps/sizes, /api/geo/downloads/size and /api/annotations/export; a GET there answers 405 before any handler runs, so another site's page can no longer make the app fetch from the network or create the annotation signing key; the POSTs sit behind the Origin middleware. The dump size and OSM size buttons and the annotation export moved with them (the export now saves annotations-bundle.json). MOVED_TO_POST in tests/test_get_cross_site_refusal.py pins each route: one POST, no GET, a GET 405, a foreign-Origin POST 403. Custody export and the heavy diagnostics follow in the next PR.
